comingLast.roast: on 21 - he will be dining out on the 33 degree heat excuse for weeks
the escape hatch: 4 points in 2 holes - all downhill from here, hopefully not literally
5 holes of runway left - 3 points clears the fence
at 1.4 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
1 point buys freedom - Johnson is pricing it higher by the minute
in on 1 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
with 2 to play he is 2 from the drop - points, please, any denomination
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
finished 3 clear of the blue balls - now buying Johnson drinks out of gratitude
